points.title: 出生与早年生活
points.description: 苏格拉底出生于古希腊雅典的一个普通家庭。他的早年生活主要在雅典度过，接受了当时的教育，包括音乐、体育和哲学。苏格拉底以其独特的教学方法和对知识的追求而闻名，他强调道德哲学和自我认识的重要性。
points.descriptionEn: Socrates was born into an ordinary family in Ancient Greek Athens. His early life was spent in Athens, where he received the education of the time, including music, sports, and philosophy. Socrates is known for his unique teaching methods and pursuit of knowledge, emphasizing moral philosophy and self-awareness.

points.title: 哲学家的生涯
points.description: 苏格拉底在雅典开始了他的哲学生涯，他通过对话和提问的方式与人们交流，探讨道德和伦理问题。他的哲学思想对后世产生了深远的影响，尤其是他的道德哲学和批判性思维方法。
points.descriptionEn: Socrates began his philosophical career in Athens, engaging in dialogues and discussions with people to explore moral and ethical issues. His philosophical ideas have had a profound impact on posterity, especially his moral philosophy and critical thinking methods.

points.title: 审判与死亡
points.description: 苏格拉底因不敬神灵和腐蚀青年罪被雅典法庭审判，并最终被判处死刑。他在监狱中度过了最后的日子，坚持自己的信念，最终饮鸩而死。苏格拉底的死亡成为了哲学史上的一个重要事件，他的思想和对真理的追求继续影响着后世。
points.descriptionEn: Socrates was tried by the Athenian court for impiety and corrupting the youth and was sentenced to death. He spent his final days in prison, steadfast in his beliefs, and ultimately died by drinking a poison. Socrates' death became an important event in the history of philosophy, and his ideas and pursuit of truth continue to influence posterity.

supporter.zh: 苏格拉底被视为西方哲学的奠基人之一，他的道德哲学和批判性思维方法对后世产生了深远的影响。他的精神遗产包括对真理的追求、对知识的热爱和对人性的深刻洞察。
supporter.en: Socrates is regarded as one of the founders of Western philosophy, with his moral philosophy and critical thinking methods having a profound impact on posterity. His legacy includes the pursuit of truth, love of knowledge, and profound insight into human nature.

critic.zh: 苏格拉底的一些观点和做法受到了批评，例如他对雅典民主制度的批评和对传统宗教的质疑。一些人认为他的哲学过于抽象，缺乏实际应用价值。
critic.en: Socrates has been criticized for some of his views and practices, such as his criticism of the Athenian democratic system and his questioning of traditional religion. Some argue that his philosophy is too abstract and lacks practical value.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，苏格拉底被视为一个复杂的人物，他的哲学思想对西方哲学产生了深远的影响。在大众文化中，他通常被描绘为一个智慧、正直和勇敢的哲学家。
objective.en: In the academic community, Socrates is seen as a complex figure whose philosophical ideas have had a profound impact on Western philosophy. In popular culture, he is often portrayed as a wise, upright, and brave philosopher.

self.zh: 未经审视的生活不值得过。
self.en: An unexamined life is not worth living.

others.zh: 苏格拉底是如此智慧，以至于他知道自己一无所知。
others.en: Socrates was so wise that he knew he knew nothing.
